entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'Sales', 'Support', or 'Returns' to be connected.
Connecting you to the next available agent.
Thanks for holding. You've reached VeloFit customer support. My name is Steve. How can I help you today?
Hi Steve, I'd like to make a return. I have an Aero Race Jersey that I need to send back.
I can certainly help you with that. Can I get your name and order number, please?
Sure, the name is Anya Sharma, and the order number is VF881-2950-B.
Okay, Anya, pulling that up now... I see the Aero Race Jersey, delivered about 40 days ago. You want to return that?
That's the one. Is that going to be an issue? I know it's been a little while.
Oh, that's **no problem** at all. Our policy allows for returns within **90 days** of delivery, so you are well within the timeframe.
Really? That's fantastic. I was worried it was too late. So, what do I do next?
I've just authorized the return in our system. I'm sending you a prepaid **return label** to your email on file right now. You just need to print it, attach it to the box, and drop it off.
Absolutely. And I see here you're a VIP member. As a thank you for your loyalty, I've also added a 20% discount code to your account for your next purchase. You should see that in the same email.
Wow, Steve, you didn't have to do that! Thank you so much, that's really great service.
It's my pleasure, Anya. We appreciate your business. Will there be anything else for you today?
No, that's everything. Thanks again for all your help!
You're very welcome. Thanks for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
